_comment: Hand-verified {event-page slug -> decision page slug} for /pdufa/* pages the automatic rules in mark_event_pages_decided.py REFUSE, and should refuse. Two shapes only: (a) several decisions by the same sponsor match the slug's drug token, so the automatic rule cannot choose (a wrong banner is worse than none); (b) the decision lives under a PARTNER's ticker, and cross-ticker matching was tried in August 2026 and rejected because it matched on shared vocabulary. Every entry names the primary source a human checked. Audit 2026-09-06 NEW-2.

links.why: Three MRK archive decisions carry the KEYTRUDA token; this page is the KEYTRUDA plus Padcev (enfortumab vedotin-ejfv) muscle-invasive bladder cancer application (KEYNOTE-B15/EV-304), goal date 2026-08-17, approved 2026-07-10. The partner page /pdufa/PFE-keytruda already carries the same decision.

Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii) first-line HER2-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma is a partner-held application; the decision page is filed under the JAZZ ticker (the JAZZ / ONC / ZYME calendar row links it). Zymeworks and Jazz co-develop; the ONC event page had no decision under its own ticker and so was never told.

Royalty Pharma holds a royalty on zidesamtinib (NVL-520); the decision lives under the sponsor, Nuvalent (now GSK). /pdufa/RPRX said the drug was under FDA review 59 days after the FDA approved it (Jideytro, 2026-07-22, goal 09-18). Shape (b): decision under a partner ticker.
2026-09-20: ABEO (Abeona) is the partner ticker on the FAYUVI (UX111/ABO-102) row; the decision is filed under the applicant, RARE. Ultragenyx 8-K 2026-09-17 acc 0001515673-26-000006.
